name: 16f lora memory budget
title: LoRA memory budget for the 7B model
subtitle: Rank 16 on all seven matrices of every block; AdamW at 16 bytes per trained parameter; bf16 base

steps.caption: Each attention matrix adds 16 x (4,096 + 4,096) = 131,072 parameters and each feed-forward matrix 16 x (4,096 + 11,008) = 241,664, so one layer adds 1,249,280.
Over 32 layers the adapters hold 39,976,960 trainable parameters, 0.59% of the model.
Only those parameters carry gradients and AdamW state: 16 bytes each is 0.64 GB, against 107.8 GB for full fine-tuning.
The frozen base still has to sit in memory in bf16, 13.48 GB, with no gradient or optimizer state. Before activations the total is 14.12 GB.
Activations come on top and barely change, since the forward pass is the same. With checkpointing about 2 GB, so the run needs about 16 GB against about 110 GB for full fine-tuning.
The trained adapter saved in bf16 is 39,976,960 x 2 bytes = 80 MB, beside a 13.48 GB base that every adapter shares.
